- No systemic symptoms

Influenza: Would have systemic symptoms and fever.
HIV: Would have systemic symptoms and other manifestations.
Bronchitis: Would have cough as primary symptom.

Pneumonia: Would have fever, cough, respiratory symptoms.
Chronic rhinosinusitis: Symptoms would be present >12 weeks.
Chagas: Tropical disease, would need exposure history.
Acute rhinosinusitis: Matches symptoms perfectly - facial pain/pressure, particularly in the cheeks and forehead.
